# How to pack a transit bin

Every item that leaves a branch for another branch travels in a gray transit bin on the [[Thistle Run|courier consolidation]] vans.

## Labels

Put the destination branch label on the short end of the bin, facing out. Each item needs a hold slip with the patron's last name and pickup branch, tucked inside the front cover. Items without slips go back to the lending branch.

## Weight limits

Keep each bin under 30 pounds, about 25 hardcovers. Heavy bins slow the sorting room and injure drivers. Put DVDs and audiobooks in a padded sleeve on top.

## Returns from other branches

Items returned at the wrong branch go in a bin labeled for their home branch. Do not mix holds and returns in one bin.
